user_query: I'm writing an article on climate change and need some inspiration. Can you fetch the latest news on climate change and provide me with a random quote in English? Additionally, it would be great if you can search for any relevant patents related to climate change mitigation technologies.

TaskList.description: Fetch the latest news articles on climate change from a news API.
Retrieve a random quote about climate change from a quotes API.
Search for relevant patents related to climate change mitigation technologies using a patent database API.
